name: Back-Office Automation Suite
description: Independent PowerShell tools with native Windows GUIs that automate an investment firm's daily reporting: CSV repair, allocation sheets, PDF splitting, SFTP and email. Each runs on its own, and they can be linked together.
highlights: TooKind: a GUI hub that syncs files with the firm's SFTP server and can launch the other tools, so staff never touch a terminal
Repairs malformed CSV exports where unescaped notes split rows and shift columns, then applies approval thresholds and negative-balance checks
Credentials are encrypted to each user's Windows account with DPAPI

media.caption: The real scripts running on fictional data: TooKind downloads files from a simulated SFTP server, StatementSplitter splits a statement PDF, and MMParser repairs and formats a money-market report. All client names, addresses, account numbers, balances, files and server paths shown are fictitious, and no real firm's data is used.
